note: Hand-determined install sets, one per source-A instance. They are NOT derivable from the repository or from the dataset: a repository declares ranges (flask says 'click>=8.0' at every commit it has ever had), so environment_setup_commit cannot answer which versions the era used. Source B escapes this because a donor's uv.lock is its owner's own recorded resolution; source A has no such artifact. Every entry here was found by hand, one incident at a time, and an instance with no entry is REJECTED at gate 3 and recorded in ineligible.json rather than resolved on the day the filter happened to run. Requirements are exact '==' only, validated against the loader's own predicate. The list is the complete install set: the runtime dependencies AND the runner, because a pin set that cannot run pytest describes an environment no task was ever verified in.

pallets__flask-5063.determined_by: Found by hand in the p1-task-ingestion dig. Resolved without pins, uv selected click 8.4.2, which removed CliRunner(mix_stderr=); four pass_to_pass tests failed and STRICT returned FAIL for a patch that was correct - a false FAIL produced by the resolution date. click==8.1.3, werkzeug==2.3.0 and jinja2==3.1.2 made the same task fully green (54 passed, executed == declared, zero skips). blinker, itsdangerous, markupsafe and pytest are era-contemporary companions of that set.
